actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Financial Services.

official_title: To amend the Federal Credit Union Act to modify requirements relating to the regulation and examination of credit union organizations and service providers, to provide the Director of the Federal Housing Finance Agency with the authority to regulate the provision of services provided to the Government-sponsored enterprises and Federal Home Loan Banks, and for other purposes.
short_title: Strengthening Oversight for the Financial Sector Act of 2026

titles.title: Strengthening Oversight for the Financial Sector Act of 2026
Strengthening Oversight for the Financial Sector Act of 2026

To amend the Federal Credit Union Act to modify requirements relating to the regulation and examination of credit union organizations and service providers, to provide the Director of the Federal Housing Finance Agency with the authority to regulate the provision of services provided to the Government-sponsored enterprises and Federal Home Loan Banks, and for other purposes.
